Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 0  
Reason for Mistake: The task was mistakenly analyzed from the beginning. The Planner misinterpreted "Amelie Or The Time To Love" as a single title or concept rather than recognizing it as two separate films: "Amelie" and "The Time To Love." This misconception led the Planner to conclude that finding the release date for a non-existent and misidentified film was necessary. As a result, WebSurfer was repeatedly tasked with resolving this ambiguity, even though no such film exists under the exact title "Amelie Or The Time To Love." The mistake lies in the failure to recognize the distinctness of "Amelie" and "The Time To Love" immediately, causing confusion and misdirection for the entire information-gathering process.
